exposure: Inotrope use in the first week of life
Duration of inotrope support in the first week of life
outcome: Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development-Third Edition (BSID-III) cognitive scores
Bayley Scales of Infant and Toddler Development-Third Edition (BSID-III) motor scores
cohort: The study included preterm infants under 29 weeks gestational age admitted to Canadian Neonatal Network NICUs between 2010 and 2011, with neurodevelopmental outcome data at 18-24 months.
finding: Infants who received inotropes in the first week of life were at increased risk for sensorineural or mixed hearing loss, and a longer duration of inotrope use was associated with lower BSID-III cognitive and motor scores, though no difference was found in overall NDI or sNDI after adjustment.
